title: Rhyme time
prompt:
A hink pink is a pair of rhyming one-syllable words that fits a short clue. For example, "a big hog" is "big pig".

What is the hink pink for "an unhappy father"? Give the two words (3,3).
hints: Which short words mean "unhappy", and which short words mean "father"?
Which of your words for father has plenty of rhyming partners?
Take the word for father and list its rhymes. Does one of them mean unhappy?
solution:
**Sad dad.**

The clue gives two meanings, unhappy and father, and the two answer words must rhyme. DAD rhymes with SAD, and SAD means unhappy.

You can work from either side: pick a word for father and look for an unhappy rhyme, or pick a word for unhappy and look for a rhyming father.
